title: Persistent LSD records and automated ST37 refresh
notes: Searching the same LSD now reopens and updates one persistent saved record instead of creating duplicates.
Notes, disposal choice, saved surface well information, first searched time, last searched time, and total search count remain attached to that LSD.
Existing duplicate LSD history entries are merged automatically while preserving saved information.
Online well searches query the live AER OneStop Well Licences layer first and the Wells panel identifies the live source.
The offline ST37 fallback now uses automatically refreshed compact files when available, with the legacy August 2026 snapshot retained only as a backup.
A scheduled GitHub updater checks the official AER ST37 Excel source daily and rebuilds the offline fallback when AER publishes a changed dataset.
